secrets.name: EXCHANGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: ExchangeRate-API key, used server-side by the /api/fiat proxy for the live USD/EUR/gold rates panel. The stored value is the old key and is over quota (provider answers 429 quota-reached), so it must be replaced with a fresh key before the panel shows numbers. Optional for boot.

secrets.name: CRYPTOCOMPARE_API_KEY
secrets.description: CoinDesk (CryptoCompare) API key, used server-side by the /api/crypto proxy for the BTC/ETH/USDT rates. A value is stored but the provider does not recognise it (401 API key required, tested with both the Authorization header and the api_key query parameter), so the real key from the CryptoCompare account page is needed. Optional for boot.
